optional-rejects-null.title: Runbook: use .nullish() to accept both null and undefined, or .nullable() if the key must always be present, which one is correct is a decision about the real data shape

deep-partial-removed.title: Runbook: mark each field optional explicitly, one level at a time, there is no direct drop-in replacement for the recursive v3 behavior

required-error-silently-ignored.title: Runbook: replace required_error (and invalid_type_error) with the single error param zod v4 actually reads, a source edit, not a callable fix

record-single-arg-rejected.title: Runbook: add the explicit key schema as z.record's first argument (z.record(z.string(), valueSchema)), a source edit, not a callable fix
